findings.name: Clutch Effects (Viejas Outlet Center)
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: ITGmania (North America). Comment: DDRMAX2 converted to ITGMania (system image) - 120hz perfect monitor! P1 is excellent but right arrow is in desperate need of new sensors, P2 remains good with original L-brackets. Updated 2026-08-01.
findings.note: Live pad rhythm (ITGmania on DDRMAX2 shell). Pipeline maps ITG/StepMania software to other, not stepmaniax. No official StepManiaX/Pump/DDR Bemani listed. Venue website confirms open Viejas FEC; does not name the pad cab.

findings.name: Cobb Theatres 17

findings.note: Cinema still operates under CMX brand; not a venue-closed finding. Arcade/GH presence after rebrand unconfirmed. Do not attach CMX movie listing as music-game evidence.

findings.name: Coin-Op Game Room

findings.note: Gaslamp 21+ barcade at 789 Sixth Ave. Former DDR SuperNOVA removed. Remaining music cab is Guitar Hero Arcade only (other).

findings.name: Conroe's Incredible Pizza Company
findings.evidence_quote: Music Game: In the Groove 2 (North America). Comment: Running OpenITG with ITG3 theme, customs enabled. Several custom and DDR song packs pre-installed... findings.note: ITG2/OpenITG pad cab is a real rhythm machine but maps to other (not stepmaniax). No official Pump/DDR e-amusement/SMX. Venue website https://www.ipcconroe.com/ confirms open FEC; does not enumerate ITG.

findings.name: CyberTag
